take:
Most Higgsfield posts here drive it from an AI agent rather than by hand. Playwright appears in 3 of these posts, Claude Code in 3 and ChatGPT in 2. @brodyautomates and @jens.heitmann both connect Claude Code to Higgsfield through the Playwright MCP plus a skills file that teaches the agent to write Seedance 2.0 prompts for ads and UGC ([Claude Code + Seedance](/e/DXKani5jWFi), [motion design team](/e/DXKFrnQEfEQ)). @tenfoldmarc posts the same recipe ([UGC skill](/e/DXIpm6TjE5M)). All three went up the same day and advertise the same unlimited-Seedance discount, so they read as a coordinated push, not independent reviews.

Features shown include Cinema Studio, where a prompt sets camera move, lens style and mood for previs or ad prototypes ([Cinema Studio](/e/DWBjCwCiVEe)), and Angles, which reframes one photo into new camera angles without a prompt and lists a free tier on mobile and web ([Angles](/e/c82dcba1352d)). @gigaqian uses it for illustrative science visuals with Seedance 2.5 ([phage explainer](/e/DbwyX1rOFn6)), and @nateherkai lists it as one character-image option in a fully synthetic influencer stack ([synthetic creator](/e/DboDjfgkVOG)).

Cost is the recurring complaint. @chase.h.ai's fork of the Scroll World skill adds budget tiers so a build does not drain the Higgsfield budget, and advises approving stills before paying for video ([Scroll World](/e/DawRY1kJ_ch)). Four entries are marked paid partnerships, with income claims, such as $14k a month from selling 3D sites to local businesses or an automated GTA 6 clip channel, that are asserted rather than shown ([local-business sites](/e/DcUsVlvpYYu), [GTA 6 clips](/e/DdSYPwEzYEU)). The ChatGPT plugin posts carry little substance beyond the caption ([floor plans](/e/DdKEdJqF3QD)).

It fits marketers and solo creators who want image and video generation steered by an agent, provided they budget for credits and test the claims themselves. Related workflows appear in [One-person creative studio](/guides/one-person-creative-studio).
